method: Local whisper.cpp small-q5_1 Arabic ASR locates content only; no ASR text is used as a religious source. Waveform RMS identifies quiet boundaries. No claims of human auditory review. omitted.reason: Different narrated ending: app follows Tirmidhi 3391 al-masir; recording follows the morning an-nushur variant. App is correctly sourced; do not overwrite its text from audio.
No confidently isolated matching complete entry in full ASR; no segment invented.
Recording includes an additional final phrase outside the current app entry. No clean independently confirmed cut before that ending.
Recording uses a different connection into the second invocation; omitted rather than silently label wording as identical.
Not enough consistent opening, ending and pause evidence to create exact clips. The full recordings remain available; this does not assert that every app entry appears in them.

sourceNotes: The cited Tirmidhi 3391 app version uses morning al-masir and evening an-nushur. Recording morning an-nushur is a different narration, not proof of an app error. https://sunnah.com/tirmidhi:3391; https://sunnah.com/abudawud:5068

verificationEvidence.firstThreeSurahs: Independent 70–145 second morning crop detected first an-Nas basmalah at 111.46 and ending 141.98, agreeing with measured final clip 111.54–141.96. Quran first passage shared between morning/evening; waveform matches give +2.39 to +2.40 second offset, correlation Ayat .918 and Ikhlas .953.
verificationEvidence.wellbeing: Independent 563–598 second morning crop contains body/hearing/sight ending la ilaha illa anta before the next refuge invocation; shared audio correlation gives evening +22.27 seconds.
verificationEvidence.hasbiyallah: Independent 657–670 second morning crop identifies the entire first recitation ending rabb al-arsh al-azim; shared audio correlation gives evening +22.27 seconds.
verificationEvidence.yaHayyu: Independent evening 937–958 crop includes the entire invocation from ya hayyu ya qayyum to tarfata ayn, followed by rawa al-hakim; evening-morning envelope match gives +22.00 seconds.
verificationEvidence.kalimat: Independent evening 1192–1219 crop explicitly identifies three successive complete repetitions. Only first selected; before second repetition. Boundaries are quiet waveform intervals 1193.94–1194.36 and 1200.67–1200.83.

limitations: These are practical content/boundary checks with local ASR and waveform data, not a claim of independent human listening or scholarly verification.
First recitation only for each entry. Do not increment completion counters for three/100 repetitions based on this one play.
Many recording passages differ in wording or include spoken commentary. Full recordings preserve those passages; per-entry clips are intentionally limited.
Whisper Arabic output has numerous spelling errors, dropped repetitions, and occasional timestamp drift. It must never replace canonical displayed Arabic.
